Flow.description: Creates all records for a customized Care Plan: the Care Plan, a Goal Assignment for each selected Goal, an Action Plan per resolved Action Plan Template Version, cleanup of the optional template tasks the advisor deselected, and any ad-hoc Tasks the advisor added at Care Plan or Action Plan level. Every query and DML statement runs outside all loops so the flow stays bulk safe. Reports outcome through isSuccess, errorMessage, skipNotApplied and taskDeleteFailed instead of a screen.
Flow.label: Apply Customized Care Plan
